x86 or Arm? Which chip runs your code faster?

Arm wins six of thirteen. On throughput, it's a tie.
x86 takes wide SIMD math, like matmul. Arm takes CRC, prime counting, and transpose.
On CRC-32, Claude reached for Arm's own CRC instruction. Two point three times faster.
Memory? Same bytes on both. Arm processes just start a little lighter.
